responsibility: This file implements a generic unordered pointer-list container for the mc-boot runtime using linked fixed-capacity blocks. It provides creation, destruction, append, indexed retrieval, index search, item counting, membership checks, duplicate-filtered insertion, removal, callback traversal, and duplication for ADDRESS values, and serves as the general lists module parallel to but separate from alists because it uses the lists API and symbolKey callback type expected by neighboring compiler components.
same_name_distinction: Implements the lists container declared in Glists.h with a concrete linked block structure and the algorithms for append, lookup, removal, iteration, and duplication. Unlike the header, it owns the internal storage representation and list-manipulation code.
